feat(driver): 合并冲突交回执行器解决，不再转人 (#148)

合并通道发现文本冲突时，把票以 PhaseCorrection 交回执行器；执行器用
driver exec --merging 启动为冲突解决器。它起一个协调会话写出每个冲突文件的
keep-ours / keep-theirs / combine-both 修复步骤，然后在 worker worktree 里合入
origin/main、按步骤解决、提交合并提交并快进推送，最后把 PR 交回合并通道复验。
不 force-push、不 rebase、不改写 origin/main。冲突解决本身在合并通道外进行，
所以通道内部仍不改写 PR 分支。

fix(driver): Linear 配额暂停按退避探测恢复，不再永久锁死 (#152)

配额低于 5% 时调度器全局暂停；暂停分支提前返回、从不调 Snapshot，
缓存的配额头永远是低值，checkLinearQuota 每轮继续暂停，永远解不开。
5 分钟退避只在 Reset 为零时生效，而 Linear 总是给 Reset。

暂停且配额仍低时，按 5 分钟退避放行一次 Snapshot 刷新配额头；
刷新后配额恢复就继续本轮调度。首次暂停先布好退避窗口，不立即探测。

+# Change shape
+
+- When the project has no external callers and no shipped data, replace the old path in the same change, update every caller, and leave no compatibility shim or data migration. When callers or shipped data exist, keep the contract they already use.
+- Delete code, files, and docs that this change made unused. If a deletion is uncertain, ask. A database delete or a data reset waits for an explicit ask.
+- When the change needs a behavior test, write the assertion, run it, see it fail, then write only the code that makes it pass. A new test locks a behavior this change can break. Style and copy changes get no new test.
+- Run the check that exercises the change and read its output before saying done. Name every path deleted. A check that did not run means the change is not done: name the check and the reason.
+- Record a correction in `~/.agents/LESSONS.md` as one line at the top: `When X, do Y`. The same mistake a second time rewrites that line. At 20 lines, merge duplicates, delete stale lines, and show the result.
+

+
+在仓库根目录运行以下命令，人和 Agent 使用同一入口。需要 [driver/go.mod](go.mod) 指定的 Go toolchain、GNU Make、Bash、Git；race 还需要 CGO 支持和 C 编译器。语言最低版本以同一文件的 `go` 指令为准。
+
+| 入口 | 行为 |
+| --- | --- |
+| `make build` | 构建所有 driver 包，不安装或重启服务 |
+| `make test` | gotestsum 运行一次未缓存的完整测试，输出摘要、JSON、JUnit |
+| `make vet` | `go vet ./...` |
+| `make lint` | golangci-lint，超时 5 分钟 |
+| `make race` | gotestsum 运行完整 race 检查，输出独立报告 |
+| `make vuln` | govulncheck；漏洞或扫描失败均返回非零 |
+| `make check` | 依次执行 build、vet、lint、test、race、vuln，遇失败停止 |
+| `make tools` | 安装固定版本的 gotestsum、golangci-lint、govulncheck |
+| `make dev-tools` | 安装版本锁文件中的全部工具 |
+
+测试相关入口默认不重跑失败测试，`-count=1` 禁用测试结果缓存。聚焦单个包或测试时使用：
+
+```sh
+make test PACKAGES=./internal/infra TEST_ARGS='-run TestRetry'
+make race PACKAGES=./internal/executor
+```
+
+工具按 [scripts/dev-tools.lock](../scripts/dev-tools.lock) 的固定版本安装到 `.omc/tools/bin`，使用 module 中指定的 Go toolchain 构建。每次使用时验证可执行文件的包路径、版本和编译器；版本不匹配则重新安装。安装不改变 `driver/go.mod`、`go.sum`、用户 PATH 或编辑器设置。首次安装需要访问 Go 模块代理；漏洞扫描还需要访问官方漏洞库。失败不会转成成功，也不自动降级到旧工具。`.omc/` 已在现有 gitignore 中排除。
+
+报告路径：
+
+- `make test`：`.omc/reports/test/tests.json`、`.omc/reports/test/junit.xml`
+- `make race`：`.omc/reports/race/tests.json`、`.omc/reports/race/junit.xml`
+
+同一入口下次执行会覆盖报告。JSON 是 Go test2json 事件流，一行一个 JSON 对象；JUnit 包含测试结果及失败。命令保持真实失败退出，不能仅以报告文件存在判断通过。不同入口的报告互不覆盖；避免在同一工作树并发运行两个 `make test` 或两个 `make race`。
+
+## Goroutine 泄漏：goleak
+
+[executor/main_test.go](internal/executor/main_test.go) 和 [scheduler/main_test.go](internal/scheduler/main_test.go) 在 `TestMain` 中调用 `goleak.VerifyTestMain(m)`，检查整包测试结束后的残留 goroutine。依赖由 go.mod 管理，仅用于测试。
+
+```sh
+make test PACKAGES='./internal/executor ./internal/scheduler'
+make race PACKAGES='./internal/executor ./internal/scheduler'
+```
+
+定位失败可以用 `TEST_ARGS='-run TestName'` 聚焦已有测试；验收泄漏修复仍要运行整包，让生命周期相互作用得到检查。先确保 context 取消、资源关闭和 goroutine 退出已被等待，再判断泄漏。保持无宽泛忽略；确有第三方常驻 goroutine 时，先证明所有权与生命周期，再评审最窄例外及原因。
+
+## 虚拟时间：synctest
+
+[infra/synctest_test.go](internal/infra/synctest_test.go) 从外部测试包调用公开 `infra.Retry`。在 `synctest.Test` 中保持 `Options.Sleep` 未设置，固定 `Random` 返回 `0.5` 消除 jitter，覆盖真实默认计时器路径。调用时点应为 0、2、6、14 秒，分别验证 2/4/8 秒退避。
+

+make test PACKAGES=./internal/infra TEST_ARGS='-run TestRetryDefaultSleep'
+make race PACKAGES=./internal/infra TEST_ARGS='-run TestRetryDefaultSleep'
+```
+
+验证新断言敏感性时，在隔离临时副本中改变退避时长、屏蔽默认 Sleep 的取消或允许取消后再调用；逐项确认测试变红，恢复后变绿。不要把 mutation 留入提交或在共享 worktree 中修改他人正在验证的代码。保留现有录制契约测试。

+```

+
+五个 job 使用仓库变量 `GO_RUNNER_LABELS_JSON` 选择 runner。变量未设置或为空时，默认标签为 `["ubuntu-24.04"]`，使用 GitHub 托管云端 runner。本地 runner 就绪后，维护者可将变量设置为 JSON 字符串数组，例如：

+```
+

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Install explicit tool versions without editing driver/go.mod or go.sum.
+set -euo pipefail
+root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
+lock="$root/scripts/dev-tools.lock"
+bin="$root/.omc/tools/bin"
+export GOTOOLCHAIN
+GOTOOLCHAIN="$(awk '$1 == "toolchain" { print $2 }' "$root/driver/go.mod")"
+[[ -n "$GOTOOLCHAIN" ]] || { echo 'driver/go.mod needs an explicit toolchain' >&2; exit 1; }
+mkdir -p "$bin"
+if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
+  mapfile -t requested < <(awk 'NF && $1 !~ /^#/ { print $1 }' "$lock")
+else
+  requested=("$@")
+fi
+for tool in "${requested[@]}"; do
+  entry="$(awk -v tool="$tool" '$1 == tool { print $2, $3 }' "$lock")"
+  [[ -n "$entry" ]] || { echo "unknown development tool: $tool" >&2; exit 2; }
+  read -r package version <<< "$entry"
+  # Verify the actual binary, not a version stamp left by a different compiler.
+  if [[ -x "$bin/$tool" ]] && go version -m "$bin/$tool" | awk \
+    -v package="$package" -v version="$version" -v compiler="$GOTOOLCHAIN" '
+      NR == 1 { built = ($NF == compiler) }
+      $1 == "path" { path = ($2 == package) }
+      $1 == "mod" { pinned = ($3 == version) }
+      END { exit !(built && path && pinned) }
+    '; then
+    continue
+  fi
+  printf 'Installing %s@%s with %s\n' "$package" "$version" "$GOTOOLCHAIN" >&2
+  GOBIN="$bin" go install "$package@$version"
+done

+# Isolated local runner
+
+Host requirements: Docker, Python 3, `gh` authenticated with repository runner administration permission, and a systemd user manager. Only the host invokes `gh`; its token is never passed to Docker. The image uses official Actions runner v2.337.0, pinned by linux/amd64 manifest digest in Dockerfile. The derived image is selected by immutable local image ID. Bash/git/make/gcc/libc headers and runner Node24 support setup-go v6 and CGO/race. The entire `_work` (checkout, tool cache, GOPATH, Go build cache, and XDG cache) is a 6 GiB tmpfs writable by UID 1001 and discarded with each container; setup-go may use GitHub remote cache.
+
+```bash
+PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/local-runner/test_supervisor.py
+scripts/local-runner/build.sh .omc/tmp/dev-tools/local-runner/image-id.txt
+# Finite validation: do this before continuous services, never alongside them.
+PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 scripts/local-runner/supervisor.py \
+  --image-file .omc/tmp/dev-tools/local-runner/image-id.txt \
+  --state-dir "$HOME/.local/state/orca-go-isolated-runner" \
+  --slot 1 --max-cycles 1 --idle-timeout 180
+scripts/local-runner/install.sh .omc/tmp/dev-tools/local-runner/image-id.txt
+systemctl --user enable --now orca-go-isolated-runner@1.service
+# Verify single instance online before enabling the second:
+systemctl --user enable --now orca-go-isolated-runner@2.service
+```
+
+Installed code/image ID live in `~/.local/lib/orca-go-isolated-runner`; services do not depend on a worktree. Durable nonsecret leases/slot locks live in `~/.local/state/orca-go-isolated-runner`. Use this same state directory for manual maintenance: different directories bypass slot locks. Only slots 1/2 exist, each with one 4 CPU/8 GiB/512 PID container. No host bind mounts, Docker socket, home, ports, or production credentials. Jobs run UID 1001, cap-drop ALL, no-new-privileges on bridge networking; sudo in the official base cannot elevate.
+
+JIT configuration travels through host memory and stdin into the entrypoint, then `ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_JITCONFIG`. Official [CommandSettings.cs](https://github.com/actions/runner/blob/v2.337.0/src/Runner.Listener/CommandSettings.cs) consumes and clears input environment variables before starting workers. [RunnerSettings](https://github.com/actions/runner/blob/v2.337.0/src/Runner.Common/ConfigurationStore.cs) defines `Ephemeral` and `DisableUpdate`; the host checks the former and sets the latter to keep the image version fixed. Runner-specific credentials exist inside the ephemeral container as required by GitHub; no host administration token is included. Never print JIT, complete environment, or runner credential files. Docker log storage is disabled; sanitized runner stdout is forwarded to journal.
+
+## Observe and stop
+
+```bash
+systemctl --user status 'orca-go-isolated-runner@*.service'
+journalctl --user -u orca-go-isolated-runner@1.service -n 30 --no-pager
+gh api repos/vmxmy/orca-factory/actions/runners --jq '.runners[] | {id,name,status,busy}'
+systemctl --user disable orca-go-isolated-runner@1.service orca-go-isolated-runner@2.service
+systemctl --user stop orca-go-isolated-runner@1.service orca-go-isolated-runner@2.service
+```
+
+Stop requests prevent another registration and detach the supervisor, preserving any live container and lease. They **do not stop an idle listener or make it offline**: the listener may receive its one job and then exits naturally. A status check is not a dispatch barrier, and GitHub's DELETE endpoint is documented as forced removal, not a guaranteed busy rejection. Therefore neither normal stop nor recovery invokes Docker stop against a live container. The finite timeout likewise stops only supervision, not the container. To drain the fleet for an image replacement, leave supervision stopped while the existing ephemeral runners complete their one job, then restart; recovery waits for natural exit before registering the new image. An idle runner with no matching job can remain indefinitely. Do not start replacement slots with another state directory to bypass this bound.
+
+`TimeoutStopSec=90s` bounds host supervisor shutdown; `KillMode=process` preserves the container/job. On restart, recovery observes only the exact owned lease and waits for container exit; STOP interrupts this waiting. Once the container is gone, GitHub registration cleanup runs. API/cleanup errors log `lease_retained` and retry on the next service start (30-second restart delay). Registration name intent is fsynced before POST. If the response is lost, recovery paginates runners and resolves the exact unique name before cleanup. If no matching registration is visible, it keeps the unresolved intent and fails closed rather than register more runners; investigate that name in GitHub before explicit maintenance. API subprocess timeouts are bounded at 60 seconds. Leases contain no JIT or credentials.
+
+The 6 GiB `_work` and 1 GiB `/tmp` maxima share the container's **total 8 GiB memory budget** with processes (swap disabled). Setup-go SDKs, Go modules, caches, checkout, and compilation outputs use this space; there is no host writable cache. This suits the initial Go jobs but is a capacity limit, not a guarantee that any build fits: ENOSPC or cgroup OOM remains a real job failure to investigate. Validate the actual five jobs before calling the capacity proven. The image's remaining writable layer is not a global filesystem quota; runner diagnostics/configuration remain there and are discarded with the container.
+
+## Manual image updates
+
+Review a new official release and pin its exact manifest digest in Dockerfile. Build and validate the new image, drain both units as above, then run install.sh with the new image-ID file and start the two units. No automatic runner updater is used. Keep the previous image ID for rollback; no automatic image pruning occurs. No production driver unit/configuration is involved.
+
+Disabling automatic updates creates a maintenance obligation: subscribe to [actions/runner releases](https://github.com/actions/runner/releases) (Watch → Custom → Releases), review new releases, and update the pinned image within 30 days of a new runner version becoming available. GitHub stops dispatching jobs to outdated runners after that deadline; a critical security update can stop dispatch immediately until updated. See the [official update policy](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/runners/self-hosted-runners#runner-software-updates-on-self-hosted-runners).
+
+## Login persistence and explicit maintenance cancellation
+
+Check `loginctl show-user "$USER" -p Linger --value`. Without `yes`, enabling the units does not guarantee they survive logout or start at boot. `install.sh` warns but does not alter this setting. An authorized administrator can use `loginctl enable-linger "$USER"`; report a privilege failure rather than silently claiming persistence.
+
+Stop means **停止补充，已有 runner 完成一项后退出** (stop replenishment; existing runners can still accept their one job). For explicit cancellation of idle maintenance runners: first move repository routing back to hosted runners, stop both supervisors, then inspect *all queued and in-progress jobs* (including runs created before the routing change) and the exact lease runner. Only after confirming no queued job targets these labels and no owned runner is busy, use `docker stop --time 30 EXACT_OWNED_CONTAINER` for the container named by that lease and matching its owner label. Recheck immediately before the stop; arrange that no one submits matching jobs during the maintenance window. Restart the supervisor to recover/delete the old registration and replenish. Never use this procedure on a busy runner; cancel/wait for its workflow through GitHub first. A routing change alone does not retarget already queued jobs.

+Description=Orca isolated ephemeral GitHub runner slot %i
+After=network-online.target
+
+[Service]
+Type=simple
+Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
+Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
+ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/lib/orca-go-isolated-runner/supervisor.py --image-file %h/.local/lib/orca-go-isolated-runner/image-id.txt --state-dir %h/.local/state/orca-go-isolated-runner --slot %i
+Restart=on-failure
+RestartSec=30
+TimeoutStopSec=90s
+KillMode=process
+UMask=0077
+NoNewPrivileges=true
+
+[Install]
+WantedBy=default.target

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""One host slot supervises one JIT ephemeral container at a time."""
+import argparse
+import base64
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import signal
+import subprocess
+import threading
+import time
+import uuid
+
+REPOSITORY = "vmxmy/orca-factory"
+LABEL = "orca-go-isolated"
+DOCKER = "/usr/bin/docker"
+GH = "/usr/bin/gh"
+STOP = threading.Event()
+
+
+def validate_workers(n):
+    if n not in (1, 2):
+        raise ValueError("only slots 1 and 2 are supported")
+
+
+def container_args(image, name, owner):
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", image):
+        raise ValueError("an immutable local image ID is required")
+    return [DOCKER, "run", "--rm", "--init", "-i", "--name", name,
+            "--user", "1001:123", "--cap-drop", "ALL", "--security-opt", "no-new-privileges:true",
+            "--cpus", "4", "--memory", "8g", "--memory-swap", "8g", "--pids-limit", "512",
+            "--network", "bridge", "--log-driver", "none",
+            "--tmpfs", "/tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,exec,size=1g,uid=1001,gid=123",
+            "--tmpfs", "/home/runner/_work:rw,nosuid,nodev,exec,size=6g,uid=1001,gid=123",
+            "--label", "orca.local-runner.owner=" + owner, image]
+
+
+def jit_payload(name):
+    return {"name": name, "runner_group_id": 1,
+            "labels": ["self-hosted", "Linux", "X64", LABEL], "work_folder": "_work"}
+
+
+def redact(message, jit=""):
+    if jit:
+        message = message.replace(jit, "[REDACTED]")
+    message = re.sub(r"\b(?:gh[pousr]_|github_pat_)[A-Za-z0-9_]+", "[REDACTED]", message)
+    message = re.sub(r"(?i)(Bearer\s+)\S+", r"\1[REDACTED]", message)
+    if re.search(r"(?i)jitconfig|authorization|credential|token", message):
+        return "[sensitive runner diagnostic suppressed]"
+    return message[:2000]
+
+
+def event(kind, **values):
+    print(json.dumps({"time": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
+                      "event": kind, **values}), flush=True)
+
+
+def owned_container(info, owner):
+    return info.get("Config", {}).get("Labels", {}).get("orca.local-runner.owner") == owner
+
+
+def command(args, data=None, timeout=60):
+    return subprocess.run(args, input=data, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
+
+
+def api(method, suffix, payload=None, missing_ok=False):
+    args = [GH, "api", "--method", method, "repos/" + REPOSITORY + "/actions/runners" + suffix,
+            "-H", "Accept: application/vnd.github+json", "-H", "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28"]
+    if payload is not None:
+        args += ["--input", "-"]
+    result = command(args, json.dumps(payload) if payload is not None else None)
+    if result.returncode:
+        status = re.search(r"HTTP (\d{3})", result.stderr)
+        code = status.group(1) if status else "unknown"
+        if missing_ok and code == "404":
+            return None
+        raise RuntimeError("GitHub runner API failed: HTTP " + code)
+    return json.loads(result.stdout) if result.stdout.strip() else None
+
+
+def inspect_container(name, owner):
+    result = command([DOCKER, "container", "inspect", name])
+    if result.returncode:
+        if "no such object" in result.stderr.lower() or "no such container" in result.stderr.lower():
+            return None
+        raise RuntimeError("Docker inspect failed")
+    info = json.loads(result.stdout)[0]
+    if not owned_container(info, owner):
+        raise RuntimeError("container ownership mismatch")
+    return info
+
+
+def runner_busy(lease):
+    runner = api("GET", "/" + str(lease["id"]), missing_ok=True)
+    if runner is None:
+        return False
+    if runner["name"] != lease["name"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("runner ownership mismatch")
+    return bool(runner["busy"])
+
+
+def finish(lease, owner):
+    info = inspect_container(lease["name"], owner)
+    if info and info["State"]["Running"]:
+        raise RuntimeError("refuse to remove a running container")
+    if runner_busy(lease):
+        raise RuntimeError("refuse to remove a busy runner")
+    api("DELETE", "/" + str(lease["id"]), missing_ok=True)
+    if info:
+        result = command([DOCKER, "rm", lease["name"]])
+        if result.returncode:
+            raise RuntimeError("container cleanup failed")
+    lease["active"] = False
+
+
+def save(path, data):
+    temporary = path.with_suffix(".next")
+    with temporary.open("w") as stream:
+        stream.write(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
+        stream.flush()
+        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+    directory = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY)
+    try:
+        os.fsync(directory)
+    finally:
+        os.close(directory)
+
+
+def resolve_intent(path, lease):
+    # A lost POST response must never lead to another unknown registration.
+    page = 1
+    matches = []
+    while True:
+        runners = api("GET", f"?per_page=100&page={page}")["runners"]
+        matches.extend(runner for runner in runners if runner["name"] == lease["name"])
+        if len(runners) < 100:
+            break
+        page += 1
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        # A POST may still be in flight or not yet visible. Retain intent and retry.
+        raise RuntimeError("unresolved registration intent; retained for next recovery")
+    lease["id"] = matches[0]["id"]
+    lease["phase"] = "registered"
+    save(path, lease)
+
+
+def recover(path, owner):
+    if not path.exists():
+        return
+    lease = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    if not lease.get("active"):
+        return
+    if STOP.is_set():
+        event("lease_retained", reason="stop before recovery; next start recovers")
+        return
+    if "id" not in lease:
+        resolve_intent(path, lease)
+    event("recover_owned_lease", name=lease["name"], runner_id=lease["id"])
+    while True:
+        if STOP.is_set():
+            event("lease_retained", name=lease["name"], reason="stop during recovery; next start recovers")
+            return
+        info = inspect_container(lease["name"], owner)
+        if not info or not info["State"]["Running"]:
+            break
+        # Even an idle listener can receive a job after an API status check.
+        # Never stop a live container during recovery; wait for natural exit.
+        STOP.wait(15)
+    finish(lease, owner)
+    save(path, lease)
+
+
+def one_cycle(args, owner, path, image):
+    name = f"orca-go-{owner}-{args.slot}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
+    lease = {"name": name, "active": True, "image": image, "phase": "registering"}
+    save(path, lease)
+    response = api("POST", "/generate-jitconfig", jit_payload(name))
+    lease.update(id=response["runner"]["id"], phase="registered")
+    save(path, lease)
+    jit = response["encoded_jit_config"]
+    # Fail closed if GitHub returns a persistent runner configuration.
+    config = json.loads(base64.b64decode(jit))
+    settings = json.loads(base64.b64decode(config[".runner"]))
+    if not settings.get("Ephemeral"):
+        finish(lease, owner)
+        save(path, lease)
+        raise RuntimeError("GitHub did not issue an ephemeral JIT configuration")
+    # The JIT settings file is runner-local; suppress auto-update to keep the image fixed.
+    settings["DisableUpdate"] = True
+    config[".runner"] = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(settings).encode()).decode()
+    jit = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(config).encode()).decode()
+    event("jit_registered", name=name, runner_id=lease["id"], slot=args.slot)
+    process = subprocess.Popen(container_args(image, name, owner), stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
+                               stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
+    def forward():
+        for line in process.stdout:
+            event("runner_output", slot=args.slot, message=redact(line.strip(), jit))
+    reader = threading.Thread(target=forward, daemon=True)
+    reader.start()
+    try:
+        process.stdin.write(jit + "\n")
+        process.stdin.close()
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        while process.poll() is None:
+            expired = args.idle_timeout > 0 and time.monotonic() - started >= args.idle_timeout
+            if STOP.is_set() or expired:
+                STOP.set()
+                event("lease_retained", slot=args.slot,
+                      reason="supervisor stopped; container left for natural single-job completion")
+                return
+            STOP.wait(1)
+        reader.join(timeout=5)
+        event("container_exited", slot=args.slot, code=process.returncode)
+    finally:
+        if process.poll() is not None:
+            finish(lease, owner)
+            save(path, lease)
+    if process.returncode not in (0, 143) and not STOP.is_set():
+        raise RuntimeError("runner container exited unsuccessfully")
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--image-file", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--state-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--slot", type=int, choices=(1, 2), default=1)
+    parser.add_argument("--max-cycles", type=int, default=0, help="0 continuously; 1 one ephemeral container")
+    parser.add_argument("--idle-timeout", type=int, default=0, help="stop supervisor after N seconds, preserving any live container/lease")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    if args.max_cycles < 0 or args.idle_timeout < 0:
+        parser.error("limits must be nonnegative")
+    validate_workers(args.slot)
+    image = args.image_file.read_text().strip()
+    container_args(image, "validation", "validation")
+    args.state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True, mode=0o700)
+    lock = (args.state_dir/f"slot-{args.slot}.lock").open("a")
+    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+    owner = hashlib.sha256((str(args.state_dir.resolve()) + REPOSITORY).encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
+    path = args.state_dir/f"slot-{args.slot}.json"
+    for sig in (signal.SIGINT, signal.SIGTERM):
+        signal.signal(sig, lambda *_: STOP.set())
+    count = 0
+    try:
+        recover(path, owner)
+        while not STOP.is_set() and (args.max_cycles == 0 or count < args.max_cycles):
+            one_cycle(args, owner, path, image)
+            count += 1
+    except Exception:
+        if path.exists() and json.loads(path.read_text()).get("active"):
+            event("lease_retained", slot=args.slot, reason="operation failed; next start recovers", path=str(path))
+        raise
+    event("supervisor_stopped", slot=args.slot, cycles=count)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        main()
+    except Exception as error:
+        event("supervisor_error", error=redact(str(error)) if isinstance(error, RuntimeError) else type(error).__name__)
+        raise SystemExit(1)

+spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("supervisor",Path(__file__).with_name("supervisor.py"))

+            path=Path(directory)/"lease.json"

+                raise RuntimeError("response lost")

+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError,"response lost"):

+            self.assertTrue(json.loads(path.read_text())["active"])
+    def test_recover_running_idle_never_stops_container(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            path=Path(directory)/"lease.json"
+            path.write_text(json.dumps({"active":True,"name":"ours","id":1}))
+            def wait(_):m.STOP.set()
+            try:
+                with patch.object(m,"inspect_container",return_value={"State":{"Running":True}}), patch.object(m,"runner_busy",return_value=False), patch.object(m,"command") as command, patch.object(m.STOP,"wait",side_effect=wait), patch.object(m,"event"):
+                    m.recover(path,"owner")
+                    command.assert_not_called()
+            finally:m.STOP.clear()
+    def test_intent_recovery_uses_exact_name(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            path=Path(directory)/"lease.json"
+            path.write_text(json.dumps({"active":True,"phase":"registering","name":"ours"}))
+            def api(method,suffix,**kwargs):

+                    return {"runners":[{"id":7,"name":"other"},{"id":8,"name":"ours"}]}
+                if method=="GET":return {"id":8,"name":"ours","busy":False}
+                self.assertEqual((method,suffix),("DELETE","/8"))
+            with patch.object(m,"api",side_effect=api),patch.object(m,"inspect_container",return_value=None),patch.object(m,"event"):
+                m.recover(path,"owner")
+            self.assertFalse(json.loads(path.read_text())["active"])
+    def test_missing_container_lowercase(self):
+        result=subprocess.CompletedProcess([],1,"[]","error: no such object: ours")
+        with patch.object(m,"command",return_value=result):
+            self.assertIsNone(m.inspect_container("ours","owner"))
